title: Checkout Service API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Checkout Service (APP-003): create a checkout session from a cart, retrieve it, and place the order. Place is idempotent on the Idempotency-Key header and orchestrates payment authorization, inventory reservation and handoff to Order Management.

title: Cart Service API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Cart Service (APP-004): create carts, add and remove line items, and read a cart with resolved pricing and applied offers. Uses optimistic-concurrency versioning and idempotency keys on mutating operations.

title: Product Catalog Service API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Product Catalog Service (APP-005): cursor-paginated product listing, product-by-SKU lookup, and active 1P/3P offer listing. Read-optimized surface for Storefront, Search and Cart.

title: Search & Browse Service API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for Search & Browse (APP-006): POST-based product search with filters, sort and facets, plus a recommendations endpoint by customer/SKU/placement. Cursor pagination and gateway rate limits apply.

title: Pricing Service API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Pricing Service (APP-007): batch resolution of effective prices for SKUs in a region/currency, plus price-list listing and retrieval. Consumed by Cart and Checkout for pricing preview and placement.

title: Promotions Engine API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Promotions Engine (APP-008): evaluate applicable promotions for a cart and validate coupon codes against a cart context. Returns applied promotions and resulting discounts with typed error envelopes.

title: Order Management (OMS) API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for Order Management (APP-009): list and retrieve orders, create orders from placed checkouts (idempotent, internal), and cancel orders prior to shipment. Backing the order lifecycle across fulfillment.

title: Inventory Service API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Inventory Service (APP-010): available-to-promise (ATP) queries for SKUs in a region and short-TTL soft reservations for checkout, with idempotent creation and explicit release.

title: Payments Service API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Payments Service (APP-012), PCI scope: authorize (with 3-D Secure challenge support), capture and refund payments against tokenized methods. Idempotent and mTLS-fronted; no raw PAN traverses the contract.

title: Storefront BFF API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Storefront BFF (APP-001): page-shaped aggregation endpoints (home, product detail) that compose catalog, pricing and availability data for the meridian.com web experience.

title: Customer Portal (My Meridian) API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Customer Portal (APP-021): authenticated profile retrieval, paginated order history, and return initiation. Self-service surface backing the My Meridian product.

title: API Gateway Admin API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 control-plane contract for the API Gateway / Edge (APP-024): register upstream routes, set rate-limit policies, and issue client API keys. Internal, platform-operator-only surface complementing gateway-enforced authN and rate limiting.

title: Identity & Customer Profile API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Identity & Customer Profile Service (APP-014): OAuth2/OIDC token issuance and customer registration/retrieval. Profile data is PII and access-controlled; tokens are JWT bearer credentials.

title: Wallet & Gift Cards API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Wallet & Gift Cards Service (APP-013): read wallet balances, post idempotent credit/debit transactions, and redeem gift cards into a customer's wallet.

title: Loyalty (Meridian Rewards) API v1
body: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Loyalty Service (APP-015): member status retrieval, paginated points ledger, and idempotent points redemption. Backs the Meridian Rewards program.

title: Order Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract published by Order Management (APP-009): OrderPlaced, OrderShipped and OrderCancelled on the mcg.orders.* topics. Envelope carries eventId, eventType, occurredAt and source; schemas evolve backward-compatibly.

title: Payment Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract published by the Payments Service (APP-012), PCI scope: PaymentAuthorized, PaymentCaptured and PaymentRefunded on the mcg.payments.* PCI-segmented topics. Payloads carry only tokenized references; no PAN is published.

title: Inventory Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract published by the Inventory Service (APP-010): AtpChanged, StockReserved and ReservationReleased on the mcg.inventory.* topics. Consumed by Checkout, Search, Storefront and the Data Platform.

title: Catalog Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract published by the Product Catalog Service (APP-005): ProductPublished, ProductUpdated and OfferUpdated on the mcg.catalog.* topics. Consumed by Search, Storefront, Pricing and the Data Platform.

title: Pricing Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract published by the Pricing Service (APP-007): PriceChanged and PriceListActivated on the mcg.pricing.* topics. Consumed by Cart, Promotions, Storefront and the Data Platform.

title: Cart Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract published by the Cart Service (APP-004): CartUpdated and CartAbandoned on the mcg.cart.* topics. Consumed by Marketing Automation, Search and the Data Platform for behavioral signals.

title: Customer Identity Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract published by the Identity & Customer Profile Service (APP-014): CustomerRegistered and ProfileUpdated on the mcg.customers.* PII-restricted topics. Only minimal identifiers are published.

title: Loyalty Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract published by the Loyalty Service (APP-015): PointsEarned and TierChanged on the mcg.loyalty.* topics. Consumed by Notifications, Customer Portal, Marketing Automation and the Data Platform.

title: Notification Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract for the Notifications Service (APP-023): consumes NotificationRequested commands and emits NotificationDelivered and NotificationFailed on the mcg.notifications.* topics. Contact details are resolved internally, not carried on the wire.

title: Checkout Events (Kafka) v1
body: AsyncAPI 2.6 event contract published by the Checkout Service (APP-003): CheckoutStarted, CheckoutCompleted and CheckoutAbandoned on the mcg.checkout.* topics. Consumed by Marketing Automation, Retail Media and the Data Platform for conversion analytics.
